dedupe_keys.name: reuse streams at uk waste facilities hwrcs

description: The Restart Project publishes records for UK household waste and recycling centres and the reuse streams publicly advertised at each site. A citizen-science investigation assembled the October 2024 snapshot to examine whether working and repairable products could be redirected from recycling into reuse. Zenodo lists the CSV dataset and an accompanying narrative report, both available under CC BY-SA 4.0 without a charge. The site-level inventory can help represent which waste facilities accept particular reuse streams and explore access or diversion scenarios. It describes publicly communicated services, not measured throughput, operating capacity or verified acceptance on a particular day. The metadata do not specify how frequently facilities were rechecked, and the underlying files were not downloaded. A modeller would need demand and capacity data from elsewhere. No related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
